stem: The sum of all the elements in the range of f(x) = Sgn(sin x) + Sgn(cos x) + Sgn(tan x) + Sgn(cot x), x ≠ nπ/2, n ∈ Z, where Sgn(t) = 1 if t > 0 and −1 if t < 0, is : [JEE Main 2026, 28 Jan Shift 1] (a) 2 (b) 0 (c) −2 (d) 4
The least value of (cos²θ − 6 sinθ cosθ + 3 sin²θ + 2) is [JEE Main 2026, 23 Jan Shift 2] (a) −1 (b) 4 + √10 (c) 1 (d) 4 − √10

Let α and β respectively be the maximum and the minimum values of the function f(θ) = 4(sin⁴(7π/2 − θ) + sin⁴(11π + θ)) − 2(sin⁶(3π/2 − θ) + sin⁶(9π − θ)), θ ∈ R. Then α + 2β is equal to : [JEE Main 2026, 21 Jan Shift 1] (a) 6 (b) 4 (c) 5 (d) 3

A tower PQ stands on a horizontal ground with base Q on the ground. The point R divides the tower in two parts such that QR = 15 m. If from a point A on the ground the angle of elevation of R is 60° and the part PR of the tower subtends an angle of 15° at A, then the height of the tower is (a) 5(2√3 + 3) m (b) 5(√3 + 3) m (c) 10(√3 + 1) m (d) 10(2√3 + 1) m [JEE Main 2022, 25 July Shift-1]
